name: Pocket Quest
description: A handheld console plays a monster-collecting adventure all by itself. The hero walks out of the village, wades through tall grass and a wild creature appears: the screen flashes, a turn-based battle plays out with menus, attacks, health bars and typed messages, then the next encounter ends with a throw of the ball. Four screen palettes, pixel grid and room glow. Every sprite, tile and letter is drawn in code, entirely offline.
author: seeWallpaper
